The bug occurs because when the Solr core is reloaded, the `UpdateLog` is not properly initialized. The code statements that fix the bug are:
```java
if (this.ulog != null && this.ulog == existingLog) {
    this.ulog.init(this, core);
}
```
Reason:
This code checks if the existing `UpdateLog` is being reused and, if so, calls the `init` method on the `UpdateLog` to properly initialize it with the new update handler and core. This ensures that the log is aware of the change and can maintain data consistency and integrity during operations.
